info.title: PixelVault API
info.description: Agent-first image hosting API. Upload images via API, get instant CDN URLs. Free tier: 200 MB storage, 500 uploads/month, 1 GB bandwidth/month.

bearerAuth.description: API key. Secret keys (pv_live_ / pv_test_) grant full access. Publishable keys (pv_pub_) are safe to embed in browser code: upload-only (POST /v1/images) and restricted to an allowlist of request Origins configured per key. Example: Bearer pv_live_xxxxxxxx

sessionAuth.description: Dashboard session token, issued by POST /v1/auth/login. Used only by endpoints a signed-in person drives from the web app (POST /v1/claim, POST /v1/uploads), never by the image API.

url.description: CDN URL. Supports on-the-fly transforms via query params: size (s|m|l|social), w, h (px, snapped to a discrete set), fit (scale-down|contain|cover|crop|pad), fmt (auto|webp|avif|jpg|png), q (auto|60|75|85), segment (foreground — AI background removal, transparent PNG), background (fill: hex, rgb()/rgba(), or a common CSS color name), gravity (auto|face|left|right|top|bottom|XxY, with fit=cover|crop), zoom (0.0-1.0, with gravity=face), blur (0-250), sharpen (0-10), rotate (90|180|270), flip (h|v|hv), brightness/contrast (multiplier, 1=no change), saturation (multiplier, 0=grayscale), tile (watermark: tile another of your project's images over the base). See the serve_image operation for the full parameter reference. Example: ?w=800&blur=30&saturation=0

optimized_url.description: Present on keyed public uploads of raster images (not SVG/GIF/private). The same image served as WebP or AVIF (negotiated per browser) at quality 85: `url` plus `?fmt=auto&q=85`. The original at `url` is unchanged. Prefer this for embeds.

expires_in.description: Present only on auto-expiring uploads: the requested TTL in seconds.

deduplicated.description: Present (true) when `dedupe=true` matched an existing image with identical bytes and nothing new was stored or billed.

replayed.description: Present (true) when an `Idempotency-Key` repeat returned the original upload's image.

post.summary: Create account and get API key
post.description: Creates an account with a default project and returns a live API key instantly. No browser or signup form needed. The password is optional: omit it for a passwordless (agent) account — the owner can set a password later via the reset flow to enable dashboard login.

password.description: Optional. Omit for a passwordless account; provide (min 8 chars) to enable password login immediately.

password_set.description: Whether the account has an owner-chosen password. False for passwordless accounts until a password is set via the reset flow.

post.description: Step 1 of a passwordless sign-in that needs no browser. Emails a 6-digit code (valid 10 minutes) to the address; creates the account first if the email is new, exactly like `register_account`. Finish with `device_login_complete`. At most one code per 60 seconds per account; disposable email domains are rejected. Needs a human (or a mailbox the caller controls) to read the code.

429.description: A code was already sent in the last 60 seconds, or the per-IP auth limit (5/min) was hit

post.summary: Exchange the emailed code for an API key
post.description: Step 2 of the email-code sign-in. Validates the code (3 attempts, single use), marks the email verified, and returns a NEW secret API key for the account's default project. Each call mints an additional key (list and revoke them with `list_keys` / `revoke_key`), unless `replace_existing` is true, which deletes older live secret keys that share the same `label`.

label.description: Name for the new key (default "PixelVault Desktop"). Shown in the dashboard and in `list_keys`.

replace_existing.description: Delete older live secret keys with the same label after minting this one, so reconnecting does not pile up keys.

200.description: Signed in. The key is shown only once.

400.description: Missing fields, `invalid_code`, `code_expired` or `too_many_attempts` (request a new code)

404.description: No account for this email; call `device_login_start` first

post.description: Upload an image and receive a public CDN URL (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, SVG). Works WITHOUT an API key: keyless uploads are temporary (response includes `temporary: true` and `expires_in`, ~30 days) — add a Bearer key to make uploads permanent. Send multipart/form-data (a file), or, with a key, application/json `{ url }` to import from a URL (https only). Retry-safe: send an `Idempotency-Key` header and a retry after a timeout returns the original image instead of storing a second copy; add `dedupe=true` to reuse an existing image with identical bytes. `width` and `height` are returned for every format whose header carries them.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Keyed uploads. A repeat with the same key and the same bytes returns the original image (200, `replayed: true`); the same key with different bytes, a different visibility, or an expired image returns 422 `idempotency_key_reuse`. A replay describes the stored image, not the retry. Keys are scoped to the project and live as long as the image. Cannot be combined with `dedupe`.

visibility.description: 'private' (secret key only) stores the image behind a signed URL and the response `url` is signed; default 'public'.

sign_expires_in.description: Signature lifetime in seconds for a private upload (60–2592000, default 3600).

expires_in.description: Optional auto-expiry in seconds (60–2592000). The image is deleted by an hourly sweep after this time, so removal can lag the TTL by up to about two hours; the response echoes `expires_in` and `temporary: true`. Omit for a permanent image (keyed uploads).

dedupe.description: Keyed uploads. When true and the project already has an image with identical bytes, the same visibility, folder and a lifetime at least as long as requested, that image is returned (200, `deduplicated: true`) and no upload is stored or counted. Best-effort: simultaneous uploads of the same bytes can each be stored. Cannot be combined with `Idempotency-Key`. Default false.

url.description: Source image URL to import (https only). Requires an API key.

visibility.description: 'private' stores the image behind a signed URL and the response `url` is signed; default 'public'.

sign_expires_in.description: Signature lifetime in seconds for a private upload (60–2592000, default 3600).

expires_in.description: Optional auto-expiry in seconds (60–2592000). The image is deleted by an hourly sweep after this time, so removal can lag the TTL by up to about two hours; the response echoes `expires_in` and `temporary: true`. Omit for a permanent image.

dedupe.description: When true and the project already has an image with identical bytes, the same visibility, folder and a lifetime at least as long as requested, that image is returned (200, `deduplicated: true`) and nothing is stored or counted. Default false.

200.description: Nothing new was stored: an `Idempotency-Key` replay or a `dedupe` match. The image carries `replayed` or `deduplicated`.

422.description: `idempotency_key_reuse`: the Idempotency-Key was already used with different image content.

get.description: Get a paginated list of images in the project.
Retrieve metadata and CDN URL for a specific image.

delete.description: Permanently delete an image from storage and CDN.

post.summary: Generate an image from a text prompt
post.description: Create an image from a text prompt with a Cloudflare Workers AI model and host it in one call. Returns the same payload as an upload (permanent CDN URL, dimensions, optimized_url) plus a `generation` block. Costs credits from your monthly grant (free 10, Starter 300, Pro 1500; credits reset on the 1st, UTC): FLUX schnell and SDXL cost 1, Leonardo models cost 20. The free plan can use flux-1-schnell only. Credits are refunded if generation or storage fails. The image also counts toward your upload and storage quotas. Requires a secret key and a verified email. Requests refused for plan, quota, credit or validation reasons never run the model. Prompts that clearly ask for adult content are refused (see the Terms of Service).

prompt.example: A minimalist hero image of a mountain at sunrise, flat illustration

model.description: Model id. Credits per image: flux-1-schnell 1, sdxl-lightning 1, sdxl-base 1, lucid-origin 20, phoenix-1.0 20. The SDXL models are in beta.

folder.description: Optional folder (letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores; max 64 chars).

expires_in.description: Delete the image after this many seconds (60–2592000).

sign_expires_in.description: Signature lifetime for private URLs in seconds (60–2592000).

optimized_url.description: Same image as WebP/AVIF; prefer it for embedding.

402.description: Out of generation credits (generation_credits_exhausted), the model needs a paid plan (model_requires_paid_plan), or an upload/storage quota was reached

403.description: Publishable keys can't generate images (generation_forbidden), or the account's email isn't verified (email_verification_required)

429.description: Rate limit exceeded: 60 generations per hour per account, or the day's overall generation capacity is used up. Carries Retry-After. Credits are refunded.

502.description: The model failed or returned no usable image (generation_failed). Credits are refunded.

503.description: Image generation is temporarily unavailable (generation_unavailable). Credits are refunded.

504.description: The model timed out (generation_timeout). Credits are refunded; safe to retry.

post.description: Upload many images in one request, grouped into a collection (e.g. a CI run). Partial-failure tolerant: each item reports ok true/false independently. Private collections return signed URLs. The collection is upserted by (type, name), so re-running the same job is idempotent.

name.description: Idempotency key within (project, type) — e.g. the CI run id.

sign_expires_in.description: Signature lifetime for private URLs in seconds (60–2592000). Defaults to 7 days.

metadata.description: Freeform collection metadata (e.g. commit, pr_number, branch).

source_url.description: Public URL to import instead of data.

402.description: Free-plan private-image limit reached (upgrade for unlimited private images)

get.description: Plan, limits and current usage for the calling key's project, so an agent can check quota before uploading. Storage is the cumulative total (what the cap enforces); uploads are the current UTC month and reset at `resets_at`. Bandwidth usage is not reported (the CDN owns those counters); the bandwidth limit is. Requires a secret key.

generation.description: AI image-generation credits (POST /v1/images/generate) for the current month.

credits_limit.description: Monthly credit grant for the plan.

403.description: Publishable keys cannot call this endpoint

get.description: Every key on the calling key's project. Hashes and raw keys are never returned; `current` marks the key that made this request. Requires a secret key.

current.description: True for the key that authenticated this request.

403.description: Publishable keys cannot call this endpoint

post.description: Mint an additional secret key for the project. The raw key is returned once and cannot be retrieved again. A project can hold at most 25 keys (409 `key_limit_reached`), and creating or revoking keys is limited to 20 changes per hour per project. To rotate: create a new key, switch to it, then revoke the old one with `DELETE /v1/keys/{id}`. Requires a secret key.

api_key.description: The raw key. Shown only in this response.

403.description: Publishable keys cannot call this endpoint

delete.description: Permanently revoke a secret key on the project (publishable keys are managed from the dashboard and return 404). The key authenticating the request cannot revoke itself (409 `cannot_revoke_current_key`). The delete only applies while the calling key still exists, so two keys revoking each other concurrently cannot leave the project without a key; the loser gets 409 `conflict`. Limited to 20 key changes per hour per project. Requires a secret key.

403.description: Publishable keys cannot call this endpoint

404.description: Secret key not found on this project

409.description: `cannot_revoke_current_key` (the key making the request), or `conflict` (already revoked, or the calling key was revoked concurrently)

post.description: Return a time-limited signed URL for a private image. The signature binds the image (and project), so the URL can't be replayed against another image. Generates the project's signing secret on first use. Use a long expires_in (e.g. for a PR's lifetime) and re-sign on updates to avoid link rot.

expires_in.description: Signature lifetime in seconds (60–2592000). Defaults to 3600 (1 hour).

expires.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the URL expires.

post.description: Returns a Stripe Checkout URL for the chosen plan. A human completes payment on that page; the plan changes only after Stripe confirms. Live secret API key (pv_live_) or dashboard token; test and publishable keys get 403. Requires a verified email. Limited to 10 requests per hour per account.

200.description: { url } to open in a browser

400.description: `invalid_plan`: plan must be starter or pro

401.description: Invalid or missing key or token

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 per hour per account)

post.description: Returns a Stripe customer-portal URL to change plan, update payment details or cancel. Live secret API key (pv_live_) or dashboard token; test and publishable keys get 403. Limited to 10 requests per hour per account.

200.description: { url } to open in a browser

401.description: Invalid or missing key or token

404.description: `no_subscription`: no billing history for this account

429.description: Rate limit exceeded (10 per hour per account)

get.description: List the project's collections, optionally filtered by type and/or name (name is the CI run id, generation id, etc.).

get.summary: Get a collection and its images

post.description: Mark a collection closed (e.g. on PR merge) and make its images eligible for the reap sweep now, ahead of their TTL.

Start an asynchronous export of every image in the project into a downloadable tar archive (plus a manifest.json of id, filename, storage key, URL, and metadata per image). Your data is always portable — no lock-in. Returns a job; poll status_url until complete, then download. Auth is project-scoped: pass a secret key to export that key's project, or a dashboard token together with a project_id query parameter.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Required only when authenticating with a dashboard token; ignored for secret-key auth (the key already identifies the project).

202.description: Export job accepted. Poll status_url until status is 'complete'.

404.description: Project not found for this account

409.description: An export for this project is already in progress

get.description: Poll an export job. When status is 'complete', the response includes download_url. Auth is the same as starting an export (secret key, or dashboard token + project_id).
Stream the completed export as a tar archive (application/x-tar) containing manifest.json plus every image. 409 if the job isn't complete yet; 410 if it has expired.

post.summary: Claim an anonymous upload into your account
post.description: Exchange the `claim_token` from POST /v1/playground/upload for a permanent image in your account. Authenticates with a dashboard session token (JWT), NOT an API key — this is the path a web user takes to keep an image they just made, without ever touching a key. Idempotent per project (enforced by a unique index, so concurrent claims cannot store duplicates): re-claiming returns the image already saved. Valid for 24 hours, after which the temporary upload no longer exists.

200.description: Already claimed — the same image, returned without storing a second copy

402.description: Storage limit reached — a plan ceiling, not a rate limit

403.description: Unverified account at the pre-verification upload cap

404.description: The account has no project to save into

410.description: The temporary upload has expired and is gone

429.description: Rate limit or monthly upload quota exceeded

post.summary: Upload an image from a signed-in session
post.description:
Store one image for the signed-in account. Authenticates with a dashboard session token (JWT), NOT an API key — this is what the web dashboard's uploader calls, so a person who has never been issued a key can still add images. The image lands in the account's default project.

Deliberately narrow: one file per request, no folder, visibility, TTL or URL import. Callers that need those should use POST /v1/images with an API key.

file.description: The image file. Max 5 MB; type is detected from magic bytes.

400.description: No file provided, or the bytes are not a supported image

402.description: Storage limit reached — a plan ceiling, not a rate limit

403.description: Unverified account at the pre-verification upload cap

404.description: The account has no project to upload into

429.description: Rate limit or monthly upload quota exceeded

delete.summary: Delete an image from a signed-in session
delete.description: Permanently delete one of the signed-in account's images (the R2 object and its record) and free its storage. Authenticates with a dashboard session token (JWT), NOT an API key — this is what the web dashboard's Delete button calls. Callers with an API key should use DELETE /v1/images/{id}. An id that does not exist or belongs to another account returns 404.

404.description: No such image in this account

post.description: Upload an image without an account or API key and get a temporary public CDN URL. Rate limited to 10 uploads/hour per IP, max 2 MB. Images are removed within 24 hours — use the authenticated upload for permanent hosting.

claim_token.description: Proof that this caller performed the upload. Exchange it at POST /v1/claim to keep the image permanently in a signed-in account. Valid for 24 hours and idempotent per project — redeeming it again returns the image already saved rather than storing a second copy.

413.description: File exceeds the 2 MB playground limit

get.description: Fetch an image from the CDN — optionally transformed on the fly via query params — from img.pixelvault.dev (not the API host). No API call or auth for public images. Transforms are edge-cached; invalid params are ignored (the original is returned, never an error); SVG sources are served as-is (not transformed). `filename` is `{image_id}.{ext}` and may be preceded by a folder path (e.g. `blog/img_abc123.png`). The effect params (segment, gravity, zoom, blur, sharpen, rotate, flip, brightness, contrast, saturation) apply to your project images, not the anonymous playground. Response headers: `X-PV-Transform` echoes the applied operations; `X-PV-Cache` is HIT|MISS.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Project ID (omit on custom domains, where it is implied by the host).

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: `{image_id}.{ext}`, optionally folder-prefixed (e.g. `blog/img_abc123.png`).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Named preset (wins over w/h). s=256w, m=640w, l=1280w, social=1200×630 OG card.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Target width in px, snapped up to a discrete set (16–4000).

parameters.name: h
parameters.description: Target height in px, snapped up to a discrete set (16–4000).

parameters.name: fit
parameters.description: Resize mode. `scale-down` (default) never enlarges a smaller source; the others fit the exact box and may upscale.

parameters.name: fmt
parameters.description: Output format. `auto` negotiates WebP/AVIF via the Accept header. Omit to keep the source format. `format` is accepted as an alias.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Output quality (discrete steps).

parameters.name: segment
parameters.description: AI background removal → transparent cut-out. Forces PNG unless a solid `background` or `fmt=webp`/`avif` is set. Project images only.

parameters.name: background
parameters.description: Fill behind a removed background (or the `fit=pad` area): hex (`%23ffaa00`), rgb()/rgba(), or a common CSS color name.

parameters.name: gravity
parameters.description: Crop gravity, with `fit=cover`/`crop`. `face` is face-aware. `XxY` = 0.0–1.0 coordinates.

parameters.name: zoom
parameters.description: Face-crop tightness, with `gravity=face`.

parameters.name: blur
parameters.description: Gaussian blur (0–250, snapped to a discrete set). 0 = off.

parameters.name: sharpen
parameters.description: Sharpen strength (0–10, snapped). 1 is a good default for downscaled images. 0 = off.

parameters.name: rotate
parameters.description: Rotate in 90° steps.

parameters.name: flip
parameters.description: Mirror horizontally, vertically, or both.

parameters.name: brightness
parameters.description: Brightness multiplier, snapped to 0.5/0.75/1.25/1.5/2. 1 = no change.

parameters.name: contrast
parameters.description: Contrast multiplier, snapped to 0.5/0.75/1.25/1.5/2. 1 = no change.

parameters.name: saturation
parameters.description: Saturation multiplier, snapped to 0/0.5/1.5/2. 0 = grayscale; 1 = no change.

parameters.name: tile
parameters.description: Watermark: the filename of another RASTER image (png/jpg/webp/avif) in the SAME project (e.g. img_logo.png — optionally folder-prefixed), tiled edge-to-edge at its native size over the base. Bake opacity into the source PNG. Must be your own uploaded raster image — not an external URL and not SVG. A missing filename is ignored (the base is served).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: HMAC signature for a signed (private) URL. When transform params are present they are bound into the signature.

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) after which a signed URL is rejected.

200.description: The image, transformed if params were supplied.

403.description: Signed URL invalid or expired, or a signed transform could not be served.

410.description: Image expired or deleted (a placeholder image is returned).

429.description: Bandwidth limit exceeded on the free tier (a placeholder image is returned).
